# Three.js r180 / 0.180.0

Unmodified official `build/three.module.min.js` and `build/three.core.min.js` from the npm package `three@0.180.0`:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

Source release: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
License: MIT, included in LICENSE.

The module's relative `./three.core.min.js` import is preserved. Both files must ship together. This release requires WebGL 2; SineDay falls back to the local still Earth when unavailable. No bundler, framework, import map or runtime CDN is required.
